rows.label: Extra solved
rows.text: Carbon cycle: forest (photosynthesis absorbs CO2) → animals (respiration releases CO2) → decomposers (release CO2) → atmosphere → ocean (dissolved CO2) → limestone (long-term storage).  ·  Nitrogen cycle: Rhizobium in pea root nodules fixes N2 → plants assimilate nitrate → animals eat plants → decomposers ammonify → denitrifying bacteria release N2.

rows.text: They may be used as part of their structural component or as parts of enzymes which influence various life processes.  ·  Nutrients are continuously exchanged between the organism and their physical environment.  ·  The cyclic movement of inorganic nutrients or essential elements between abiotic environment and biotic communities is called biogeochemical cycle.
